name: title-state-types
summary: Title stat bonuses (CharacterTitleStateServer) live in a [128 types][4 levels] array of 0x4C-byte records inline at the start of the one CCharacterTitleDataStateServer object, and its loader does not bound the type: a row for a 2026 title (type 128..149) would be written over the table reader that sits right after the array. Move the array to its own 256-type region and point every user at it.
status: BUILT 2026-09-23 with the title_ext plugin (title status past 127) and character-title-types. Statically verified.
why: CCharacterTitleDataStateServer (one global, 0x1328C128; loaded by zs_start_moon) = CT_DataState rec[128][4]
(0x4C bytes each: count u8, then up to 6 {abstate, strength} slots) followed at +0x9800 by the CDataReader of
Read            0x5CA790  row -> rec[Type*4 + TitleLV], NO bound on Type; base = [ebp-0x90] (this) at 0x5CA887
and 0x5CA92B, and the loop head's mov esi,ecx then uses this + 0x9800 as the reader
GetStateData    0x5CA9B0  cmp al, 0x7F ; ... ; add eax, ecx     (callers: map-login-complete, revive)
sp_NC_CT_SET_CURRENT_REQ  two inlined copies: cmp al, 0x7F and add eax, 0x1328C128 (old + new title)
So 2016 simply had no rows past 127; a row for 2026's new titles (the 2026 client describes 78 bonuses for types
128..149, CharacterTitleStateView) would land on the reader. The array moves to a zero-filled region of
256 x 4 records (the type is a byte), and:
* GetStateData is rewritten in place (37 of its 42 bytes): type unbounded (a byte), level <= 3, new base;
* both inlined lookups get the new base and a 0xFF bound;
* Read loads the NEW base at both sites (mov ecx, imm32 ; nop in place of mov ecx, [ebp-0x90]); since ecx
then carries the new base into the loop head, the reader address there becomes the absolute
0x1328C128 + 0x9800 - there is exactly one such object. Read's stock clear loop still clears the old
array, which nothing reads any more; the new region starts zeroed.
ABSOLUTE ADDRESSES: the imm32s written into formerly register-relative instructions have no relocation entry;
like the zone's other code caves this relies on the exe loading at its preferred base (it does: 0x400000).
The bonus ROWS for types 128..149 are data (Fiesta2026on2016 migration).

edits.why: GetStateData rewritten in place (guard on the stock first bytes; the code blob writes the rest)
set-current, old title: state array base
set-current, new title: state array base
Read: record base (count check / slot) - mov ecx, imm32 (opcode)
Read: record base - the new array
Read: count increment base - mov ecx, imm32 (opcode)
Read: count increment base - the new array
Read: loop-head reader address, absolute (ecx now carries the new base) - opcode
Read: loop-head reader = the one object + 0x9800
